design.name: 冰棘豪彘
design.brief: The haozhi (豪彘) of the Shan Hai Jing, a pig-like beast with white quills like hairpins, frozen into a charging kamikaze: a compact stocky porcupine-boar about 1.4 m long, grey-blue bristly skin, a big crown of long thick white-and-ice-blue quills over the whole back that bristle up when angry, small tusks, a flat snout, tiny glowing cyan eyes, short legs with small cloven hooves. The quill roots on its back glow cyan-violet as it builds up to burst (weak spot: its whole quill crown). Grumpy and explosive.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps. Quills are a few dozen thick simple cones, not hundreds of thin needles.
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a real boar (quadruped): body level, the four short legs straight under the body and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated; head facing straight ahead, mouth closed with the small tusks showing; the quill crown relaxed and lying back along the back as thick solid cones (not bristling up); the quill roots only faintly cyan-tinted (no glow halo, no particles)
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with two cloven hoof toes; the whole quill crown fully inside the frame; in the side views the body must fit inside the view with margin.
